Bug_Title: UR: Uninitialized read of field method called from constructor of superclass (UR_UNINIT_READ_CALLED_FROM_SUPER_CONSTRUCTOR)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the code by calling the getValue method in the constructor of the superclass A before it has been initialized in the subclass B. This results in an uninitialized read of the field 'value'.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered during the construction of the B object, when the A constructor is called. A's constructor calls the getValue method before B's constructor has initialized the 'value' field. This results in reading the uninitialized 'value' field.
